source: MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com), MLB Advanced Media's public API and already the site's source of schedules, rosters and injured lists. Its notice permits individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use; the site is non-commercial, the calls are paced and cached, and only facts (dates, clubs, players, the kind of move) and our own numbers are shown, never MLBAM's text. Contracts and salaries are not shown: no source with terms that allow our use has them (Spotrac, Cot's Contracts, Baseball-Reference and FanGraphs forbid this kind of reuse).
notes: Facts from the MLB Stats API's transactions, parsed into the kind of move; minor-league contracts, assignments within a system and number changes are left out.
Injured list: the list's length (10, 15 or 60 days; 7 for concussions), the date the placement is retroactive to when it differs, and the body part (a category we read from the placement).
